correctness.rationale: The 3-uniform substitution gives w(3n)=w(3n+1)=w(n), w(3n+2)=1-w(n); adjacent differences satisfy d(3n)=0, d(3n+1)=1, d(3n+2)=1-d(n). For a square period p, adjacent-difference comparisons rule out all p nonzero modulo 3 (including p=2 by direct residue check); restricting p divisible by 3 to positions divisible by 3 reduces to a square with period p/3. Therefore only p=3^k. Complementary length-L substitution blocks force precise starts i=qL+r: r=0 requires adjacent equal parent letters; r>0 requires a parent triple; cube only at r=0 with parent triple; no fourth power. Recurrence for D(N)=# differences ones proves density 1/2 for changes and 1/6 for parent triples, yielding square density (L+2)/(6L) and cube 1/(6L). Both 0- and 1-triples occur; primitive odd L blocks generate two disjoint length-L cyclic conjugacy classes, hence exactly 2L distinct least-period-L square words. Independent literal comparison on length-19683 fixed point verified square/cube statements and no fourth powers for all periods <=149, part of 5,875,875 cumulative assertions. All-power proof comes from substitution recurrences.
